question: Should OpenClaw keep `contextPruning.ttl` as a tool-result prompt-cache optimization, or add an admin-scoped API/semantic contract for pruning or summarizing conversation history mid-session?
rationale: The source-proven gap is real, but the desired behavior changes session retention, transcript, and privileged mutation semantics that ClawSweeper should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design admin-scoped pruning semantics
options.body: Specify the protocol/gateway API, auth scope, transcript or summary behavior, and tests before implementing conversation-history pruning.

options.title: Keep current pruning semantics
options.body: Document that TTL never expires normal conversation text and route users to `/compact`, `/reset`, `sessions.reset`, and `sessions.compact` instead.

options.title: Split into narrower items
options.body: Use the related open issues for REST session APIs, rolling pruning, manual tool-result clearing, and session max lifetime while keeping this as the umbrella only if maintainers want one.

recommendation.title: Design admin-scoped pruning semantics
recommendation.body: Specify the protocol/gateway API, auth scope, transcript or summary behavior, and tests before implementing conversation-history pruning.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the core pruning/reset behavior and already left the strongest live review signal on this issue.
